requirements.desc: When flow-scope test-review returns a semantic FAIL and attemptsBefore + 1 is greater than or equal to maxAttempts, the review post-hook must create or update flow-findings.json during that same command lifecycle.

The post-hook deferred entries must be created from unresolved blocking findings in the latest test-review.json and include findingId, sourceStep=test-review, sourceArtifact=test-review.json, sourceFindingId, retryExhausted=true, attempts, round, completionKind=deferred, and finalDisposition=still_open.
requirements.note: R2: deferred entry contains required test-review retry exhaustion metadata

requirements.desc: After semantic deferral in the final FAIL post-hook, test-review must be marked complete through the existing done traversal model so get status does not leave test-review in_progress and get next-action can return implement or a later step.
requirements.note: R3: semantic deferral marks test-review complete through the flow manager

requirements.desc: The final FAIL post-hook semantic deferral must reuse the existing semantic deferral helpers or an equivalent shared helper so pre-check and post-hook carryover use the same source artifact, finding id, exclusion, and step-completion behavior.
requirements.note: R4: post-hook deferral shares the same source artifact and finding id as pre-check deferral

requirements.desc: TOOLING_FAILURE and structured test-review coverage/header failures must remain excluded from semantic deferred carryover and continue to require tooling recovery, structured coverage recovery, or existing override behavior.
requirements.note: R5: tooling and structured coverage failures stay outside semantic carryover while semantic failures still defer

requirements.desc: Semantic exhaustion carryover must run even when retryRecovery.recoveryPossible=false or unchanged-evidence would prevent a retry reset, because the carryover is the final retry-exhaustion state transition rather than another retry attempt.
requirements.note: R6: unchanged-evidence recovery state does not block final semantic carryover

requirements.desc: The carryover path must not create duplicate deferred entries for the same sourceStep, sourceArtifact, and sourceFindingId when pre-check or repeated invocations encounter an already-carried finding.
requirements.note: R7: repeated carryover for the same source finding does not append duplicates

requirements.desc: Acceptance-review must recognize test-review deferred findings from flow-findings.json in deferredFindings; still_open findings may produce amend_required under current policy, blocking findings produce blocked, and explicit user-decision state must produce user_decision_required with nextAction=user_decision and targetStep=implement.
requirements.note: R8: acceptance-review receives deferred findings created by the post-hook path

requirements.desc: Existing manual review retry reset behavior must remain available for review phases and must not be removed or weakened by the post-hook carryover implementation.
requirements.note: R9: post-hook carryover preserves reviewRetry evidence for manual retry reset workflows
